plot_summary: Tony Stark, reflecting on his cold and distant father, travels back in time to 1970. He encounters a younger Howard Stark, who is anxiously awaiting the birth of his son. Posing as a visitor, Tony has a heartfelt conversation with his father, offering him reassurance about fatherhood. This interaction allows Tony to see his father in a new light, understand his love, and find closure, ending with a posthumous message from Howard calling Tony his greatest creation.
